title: Credential delivery
text: The terminal waits while authorization is pending, then finishes on one-time credential consumption, denial or expiry. The engine owns personal decisions and atomically issues and consumes the credential; only one successful poll receives the raw token. Hosted machine_authorization.handoff_poll uses the original device secret and explicit engine org_id under service-only authority, avoiding a shared proxy-address admission bucket. Invite redemption instead consumes one private code and atomically records the invited person's machine and credential audit. The CLI verifies the returned server origin, health and identity before saving the credential in an owner-only file; it never prints the code or credential. A lost invite response cannot be replayed: ask an admin to reissue and retire any stray machine. An install below the handoff serving floor names the control-plane operator rollout recovery. Consumer source adoption is observed; production approval and delivery proof remain pending.
